environment.description: Lambda function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalConverterRole with condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4. The function URL endpoint resolves publicly but returns HTTP 403 with body '{"Message":"Forbidden"}' for any request lacking a valid SigV4 signature from the authorized principal. Reserved concurrency is set to 1, serializing all executions and collapsing the race window to near-zero even for authorized callers. CloudWatch contributor insights enabled on the function for anomaly detection.
